annotations.text:
Loading.
Anything that is not data renders for real — the header, the segmented control, the form's heading. Only the data-shaped regions become skeleton, at the exact heights of what replaces them, so nothing shifts on arrival.
No shimmer: design.md §2 reserves looping motion for .ai-dot, and a database read is not the AI working.

Failure.
Each board says what happened and what survives, then offers the machine-readable half in a detail well underneath — never in the headline. Peach is for things that broke; a wrong address gets a neutral tile.
